roles_zh: 中国人民解放军创建人之一
中华人民共和国十大元帅之一
roles_en: One of the creators of the People's Liberation Army
One of the Ten Marshals of the PRC
summary_zh: 叶剑英（1897-1986），广东梅县人，中国人民解放军创建人之一、中华人民共和国十大元帅之一。从黄埔军校时期到改革开放，跨越中国现代史多个关键节点。以卓越的战略决策能力、情报工作建树和军事外交贡献闻名，在遵义会议、抗战时期、解放战争、抗美援朝及改革开放初期均发挥了关键作用。
summary_en: Ye Jianying (1897-1986), born in Meixian, Guangdong. One of the creators of the People's Liberation Army and one of China's Ten Marshals. Spanning from the Whampoa Military Academy era to the reform and opening-up period, he played key roles across multiple critical junctures of modern Chinese history. Known for exceptional strategic decision-making, intelligence work achievements and military diplomacy contributions.
key_events_zh: 1917年入云南讲武堂，后转入广东陆军小学
1924年入黄埔军校任教，参加北伐战争
1927年加入中国共产党，参加广州起义
1934年长征中担任红军总参谋长，遵义会议关键支持者
1936年西安事变中参与和平解决
抗日战争时期任八路军参谋长
解放战争时期任北平军事调处执行部中共代表
1949年后参与新中国国防建设和军队正规化
文化大革命中维持军队稳定，保护大批干部
1976年粉碎四人帮的关键决策和执行者
改革开放时期参与军队现代化建设和国际军事外交
key_events_en: 1917: Entered Yunnan Military Academy, later transferred to Guangdong Army Primary School
1924: Taught at Whampoa Military Academy, participated in the Northern Expedition
1927: Joined Chinese Communist Party, participated in Guangzhou Uprising
1934: Served as Red Army Chief of General Staff during Long March, key supporter at Zunyi Conference
1936: Participated in peaceful resolution of Xi'an Incident
Anti-Japanese War: Served as Chief of General Staff of Eighth Route Army
Liberation War: CCP representative at Beiping Military Dispute Executive Commission
Post-1949: Participated in New China's defense construction and military regularization
Cultural Revolution: Maintained army stability, protected numerous cadres
1976: Key decision-maker and executor in crushing the Gang of Four
Reform era: Participated in military modernization and international military diplomacy
